properties.notes: 5-story, 80-room 'free home away from home' (Family House's About Us page) for families with children being treated at UCSF Benioff Children's Hospital (same page); OCII Resolution No. 10-2014 describes it as for families of patients primarily receiving treatment at UCSF Mission Bay Medical Center. Free lodging ('always 100% free of charge' per Family House's rooms page), run by Family House, Inc. Family House's history page (undated) says the 80-bedroom house opened in Mission Bay in 2016; the Assessor gives year built 2016. No page read calls Family House a nonprofit; the Assessor's welfare exemption on the parcel is consistent with a nonprofit operation but does not say so.
